summary_md: **Hackers Online Club (HOC) ([@HOCupdate](https://x.com/HOCupdate/status/2115483098456662352))** covers **NVIDIA SkillSpector**, an open-source security scanner for AI agent skills and MCP servers.

referenced_urls.title: NVIDIA SkillSpector: Complete Security Scanner for AI Agent Skills & MCP

relevance: A vendor-backed scanner for the skill/MCP supply chain.

media.description: Infographic 'How NVIDIA SkillSpector Works': an agent skill or MCP package is ingested (Git, URL, zip, local folder), checked by a static analysis engine (AST taint tracking, YARA, OSV.dev CVE lookups) and LLM semantic analysis (description vs behavior mismatch, prompt injection, MCP over-privileging), producing a verdict as SARIF/JSON/Markdown/terminal reports.
